_comment: 'When this hits a hero, mark them. Go again' -- Go again is printed and UNCONDITIONAL here, so it is deliberately not authored and no conditional_keywords declaration is made: gating it would silently take away a keyword the card really has. MARK targets the opponent by default (ability_keywords.effect_mark), which is the hero this attack hit; ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO is what makes 'hits a HERO' real, since an attack can hit a permanent.
